Native SwiftUI iOS app for Hotlympics face rating, leaderboards, photo uploads, and profiles. Bundle ID: `hotlympics.ios-app`; preferred simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In (Swift Package Manager).

Commands:
```sh
open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj
```
After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Main entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` (Firebase, Google Sign-In URL schemes). Five tabs: Rating and Leaderboard are unrestricted; Upload, My Photos, and Profile require authentication and complete profile.

Services: FirebaseAuthService (Google OAuth, sessions, backend profile sync); ImageQueueService (active/buffer blocks of 10, opposite-gender filtering, reset on auth changes); RatingService; ImagePreloader (shared NSCache, 50-image limit, clears on memory pressure); UploadService (signed URL, compressed Firebase Storage upload, progress, backend confirmation); UserService (5-minute cache, preload, refresh after updates, optimistic deletion/removes deleted photos from pool).

Upload crops to 400x400; pool selection max 2. User photo/pool updates refresh cache. Base URL in Constants.swift: `https://hotlympics-server-670297845147.us-central1.run.app`. API: `GET /images/block?gender={gender}&count={count}`, `POST /ratings`, `GET /leaderboards/{gender}`, `POST /images/request-upload`, `POST /images/confirm-upload/{imageId}`, `GET /images/user`, `GET /user`, `PUT /user/profile`, `POST /user/accept-tos`, `PUT /user/pool`, `DELETE /images/{imageId}`.
